lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with larger centroid diameters concentrated in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the horizontal alignment of blobs, forming a grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges on the upper flank defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, showing high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible within the first dorsal fin mask, primarily in the lower and anterior regions.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density clustering of smaller high-luminance blobs relative to the primary lateral flank patterning.
